dialogue.content: lost twenty minutes to a map of somewhere I'm not going.
answered a run of quick questions over a day. all handled.
moved two things on the calendar and called that admin done.
finally replied to the thread from last week.
when I'm reachable all day I answer everything at the surface and finish none of it. when I've been unreachable a while it comes out all at once instead.
one long go, rather than forty small ones.
someone sent a photo from years ago and derailed my afternoon.
muted one group and un-muted another. net zero.
walked the long way home and didn't check my phone.
made a playlist for a thing that hasn't been planned yet.
booked the haircut I've been putting off since spring.
was uncontactable for a weekend and nothing broke.
left a voice note instead of typing. felt strange.
cleaned the kitchen instead of answering anything.
the people who say I was there for them are the ones who got the whole thing in one go. the ones I answered every day never got more than the top layer, and they know it.
one of them has, in as many words.
skimmed the invites and closed the tab.
someone changed the group name again.
ate standing up reading a thread I wasn't in.
found a birthday I'd forgotten and covered it with a message.
said maybe to two things I already knew the answer to.
